create_LLM_instance: create an LLM instance from params that loads a model, tokenizer, and embedding matrix via llm_loader
run_model_forward: run a forward pass on a query sequence to get predicted logits with mask-aware sorting
compute_teacher_forced_loss: compute the prediction loss using teacher-forced generation with provided loss parameters and labels
generate_autoregressive: generate autoregressive text samples from a prompt context using the model's generation config
prepare_prompt_sequence: prepare a merged prompt sequence from a template by converting context messages into token sequences
